theory.heading: What Azure Functions is
theory.body: Azure Functions describes the methods and patterns used within Azure Administrator (AZ-104) to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Azure Functions is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Azure Functions matters
theory.body: Without Azure Functions, systems built with Azure Administrator (AZ-104) are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Azure Functions works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Azure Functions follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Azure Functions.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Azure Functions
theory.body: Azure Functions offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
